entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states using temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is an official Hermes Agent provider available as a managed cloud service or an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking organizes agent context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a three-tier loading system to reduce token consumption. This AGPL-3.0 context database offers observable retrieval trajectories and demonstrated significant task-completion gains in LoCoMo10 benchmarks.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated memory brain extracts typed entity edges for graph-based retrieval without requiring LLM calls. It features gap analysis to identify missing knowledge and enforces verified zero-leak access controls for multi-user data scoping.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory utilizes a custom vector graph engine to provide sub-300ms recall and byte-level deduplication for high-volume token environments. It automates fact extraction and user profiling through connectors for platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows to create agent memory that learns over time. It supports over 25 LLM providers and is deployable via Docker, Kubernetes, or native Python and Node.js clients.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a FastAPI-based library that enables reasoning-first memory by extracting conclusions from conversation history. It serves as the upstream foundation for self-hosted Hermes wrappers and supports managed, local, and Docker deployments.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This Elastic License 2.0 provider treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging for markdown context trees. It achieves sub-100ms performance using a five-tier retrieval system, four of which function without LLM overhead.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency system that uses a single SQLite database to achieve sub-millisecond memory operations. It features episodic compression for sub-linear storage growth and integrates via MCP, Python SDK, or OpenWebUI.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer system utilizes Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage persistent vector search and structured facts. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected context and maintains an auto-curated wiki.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that stores run data as filesystem-first artifacts and traces. It uses outcome-gated promotion to update context based on verified trials and integrates via CLI or MCP clients.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management by storing messages in a SQLite-backed system with FTS metadata. It builds depth-aware summary nodes in a hierarchical DAG, allowing agents to search and expand compacted material without losing original data.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project enables private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent by providing a self-hosted backend for the Honcho library. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible or local inference server.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI provides a local-first identity and memory layer that enables portable state across Hermes Agent and other clients like Claude Code. It achieves a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy and supports data imports from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to store data locally as human-readable files. It integrates with Hermes-compatible tools via MCP and employs hybrid retrieval using BM25 and local embedders.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It uses hybrid retrieval, combining BM25 and vector search, to provide memory through MCP and agent hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes long-context inference for Hermes Agent by using block reordering and deduplication to enhance prefix reuse. These optimizations reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3× and can save up to 36% in token usage.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases. Its five-package plugin family includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recalled memory. It features a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack serves as a memory kernel for Hermes by integrating Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets for agent queries.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs and storing data locally via SQLite-vec. It functions as an MCP-native server with automated configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn provides cross-project memory for coding agents by using an Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores memory in inspectable Markdown files and utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep is a reflective memory tool that supports semantic search through BM25 and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for codebases and multimedia, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves workspace states into verified facts and rendered context files to reduce prompt tokens by up to 94%. It operates as a local-first tool or MCP-native server, utilizing SQLite and FTS5 for persistent storage.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces Hermes Agent prompt overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas. It includes a dashboard for tracking token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single .lbdb embedded graph database file to manage agent memory. It features importance-weighted recall to surface high-priority entries during prefetch and supports BM25 keyword search alongside named graph relationships.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This tool provides a Git-backed workflow layer that stores project instructions and state in reviewable Markdown files. It includes a migration workflow for importing documents and chat history, utilizing host-neutral lifecycle commands for session management.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that supports immediate event deletion and provides a trace.jsonl audit log of all memory operations. It addresses specific community issues by using an on-demand summarizer to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It ensures reliability via a local SQLite layer and a write outbox, offering tools to search, remember, and update agent state.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables Hermes agents to handle payments using USDC and stablecoins across ten chain families, including EVM and Solana. It allows APIs and agents to programmatically charge for services or pay for resources with a few lines of code.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, scripts, and runbooks to facilitate capability routing for the agent. It provides tools for artifact search and graph neighbor traversal, supporting both manual and implicit feedback to optimize routing.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve the retrieval of manually stored or searched memories.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution offers AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports multiple retrieval methods including HNSW ANN and sparse search. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, requiring a local SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage. it adds deterministic slash commands for searching and reading files, supporting models with structured tool use.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider features 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also performs automatic context checkpointing during message compression to maintain state.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: A file-based curation loop that uses a git-backed directory of Markdown files instead of a traditional database. It includes 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data and proposes evidence-cited diffs for manual review.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven methodology to execute engineering tasks autonomously. It enforces a structured workflow of brainstorming, planning, and test-driven development to ensure reliable software creation.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that provides 26 CLI executables for design and prototyping tasks. It enables agents to export artifacts into multiple formats like HTML and MP4 while offering a sandboxed iframe for live iteration.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST AI RMF. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering a comprehensive security layer for agent operations.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee serves as a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that grants agents persistent long-term memory across sessions. By combining vector embeddings with graph-based reasoning, it allows agents to maintain complex context through Python, Rust, or TypeScript clients.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables the generation of editable .drawio files from natural language descriptions or Mermaid text. It includes 11 diagram presets and features self-check capabilities to automatically fix errors in the generated output.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Acting as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project facilitates natural-language mandates and delegated permissions. It integrates escrow, x402 payments, and dispute resolution to secure autonomous transactions.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate 62 distinct categories of detectable AI writing patterns. It supports rewrite and edit-in-place modes, making it compatible with agents like Hermes and Claude Code.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw allows for the collective evolution of agent capabilities through skill merging and cross-pollination. It features a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and supports multiple APIs including Hermes and QwenPaw.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library offering 12 metaskills that preserve state within a dedicated documentation folder. These spec-conformant plugins are designed for compatibility with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection features 1,153 markdown-based skills for professional and life tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent. It includes ready-to-paste exports and integrations for platforms such as Slack, Obsidian, and n8n.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This project provides agents with the ability to search YouTube, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It is compatible with Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and Cursor, requiring a TranscriptAPI key for operation.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom analytical instructions and domain-specific thinking lenses for complex tasks. It enhances transparency by reporting findings alongside a dedicated analysis of potential blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides modular packages for Pydantic AI that support instructions, resources, and scripts through a type-safe framework. It utilizes progressive disclosure to improve prompt efficiency and supports integration with remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill automates the transition from rough concepts to structured design and implementation documents using Lite and Full modes. It includes a formal spec review gate that utilizes evaluation models to issue PASS/FAIL ratings.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into unified .lit.md files. It features a tangler to extract runnable code and automatically synchronizes source file edits back into the primary documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro provides a harness for long-running agents featuring a three-level work model and structured memory backed by files or SQLite. It includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards to facilitate cross-feature learning and plan-approve-execute workflows.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions and outcomes in markdown files. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning tasks to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Built on the Agent Skills specification, this project allows agents to interact with oracle networks and smart contracts via CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. It includes specialized capabilities for CRE and ACE services to ensure blockchain interoperability.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This repository serves the Brazilian community with installation guides and skills formatted for the agentskills.io standard in Portuguese. it provides localized resources to help users configure and deploy Hermes Agent effectively.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide API integration patterns and prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 image generation models. The toolkit includes specialized capabilities for creating cinematic inserts and product advertisements.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories and developer discourse into version-pinned skills with audit trails and provenance maps. It links instructions to specific file lines at pinned commits and requires Python 3.10 and Node.js 22 or higher.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with built-in recursive dependency resolution. It features a Python client, a dedicated CLI, and supports commerce through TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex multi-step tasks by providing autonomous execution with real-time progress and decision tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This project provides a local-first workflow language that audits AI operations for costs, permissions, and types before execution. It uses a single Rust binary to generate tamper-evident, hash-chained receipts for every run.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables management of files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incremental metadata retrieval.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This retrieval system uses a five-layer approach, including semantic embeddings and hard triggers, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. It is designed to reduce token consumption and offers graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: This personal execution system uses a local SQLite database to manage habits and study blocks without cloud synchronization. It allows users to complete tasks via physical tapping while an AI agent manages system design through the Model Context Protocol.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub implements the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification for community skill browsing and one-click installation. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review tool employs three parallel subagents to perform adversarial, edge case, and integration audits. It combines deterministic pre-scans with a hardened sandbox to verify findings through proof-of-concept execution.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across multiple interfaces like Discord and Telegram to reduce token usage by 20–80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine to maintain persistent task states during causal debugging.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This multi-agent skill uses three specialized agents to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It features a tiered application process that requires an approval gate before changes are finalized.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern supports automatic registration of skill directories. It utilizes SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure and integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool loading.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey laboratory provides over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and covers real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit provides production-tested session management to maintain memory across agent conversations and orchestrates parallel subagents for code reviews. It also includes specialized tools for worktree recovery, state drift detection, and skill scaffolding.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible recording scripts and optimized GIFs for repository documentation. It handles the full pipeline from generation to embedding rendered files directly into a README.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This project generates portable agent skills from plain language while ensuring they remain compliant with current frontmatter specifications. It features a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to detect and report drift against official runtime profiles.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills. It facilitates the discovery and direct installation of tools for compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols such as Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and the Hermes Agent.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This utility certifies the structure, functionality, and security of agent skills by testing them within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to confirm a skill actually works.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills provide deterministic path routing and interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. They allow agents to verify existing project-compatible Python runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows agents to participate in USDC bounty settlements on the Base network without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for listing bounties, buying context, and managing bounty boards.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This news briefing generator produces structured reports across multiple geographic scales, from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and applies quality gates to AI-generated analysis.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection offers local OCR for documents and video-to-text extraction for platforms like Douyin. It also supports batch e-commerce material generation featuring brand overlays and text de-humanization.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project exposes 191 tools via an MCP server to provide structured web data across 31 different platforms. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with agents like Claude, Cursor, and OpenHands.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, that are automatically updated on a daily basis. It supports both open-source and proprietary licensed tools for use within Nix-based development environments.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI integrations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a one-line installation script for deploying Hermes Agent in Termux environments on Android. It supports persistent memory for user preferences and is compatible with both local models via Ollama and various cloud API providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart deploys Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports direct deployments or operator-ready workflows and includes a configurable gateway mode with optional API listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to Android via Termux and iOS via iSH. The deployment supports scheduled tasks through cron jobs and integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed deployment environment for Hermes Agent using hardware-enforced security via NVIDIA OpenShell. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a Docker sandbox image that includes official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows users to build specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying and operating Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, LLM budget caps, and management interfaces via REST API, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration using systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It facilitates inter-agent delegation with hierarchy-aware communication and enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This headless deployment option configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It is designed for production-ready autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable production package that runs from USB drives without host installation or registry writes. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework focuses on financial trading by coordinating specialized agents for sentiment, technical, and fundamental analysis. It supports multiple LLM providers like OpenAI and Anthropic, utilizing a Portfolio Manager to oversee final transaction approvals and execution.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control provides a self-hosted orchestration layer for governing agent registration, memory browsing, and cost tracking across multi-agent workflows. It offers flexible access through Web UI, CLI, and REST API interfaces with support for local Node.js or Docker deployments.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages parallel coding agent sessions, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, using tmux for session persistence. It ensures secure execution by providing sandboxing through Docker, Podman, and Apple Container environments.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This project serves as an MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain, supporting Claude-style MCP protocols in stdio mode. It includes specialized detection for HTTP signals to manage payment-required states for paid API services.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this template scales Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills specifically for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: Swarmclaw enables the creation of autonomous agent swarms with support for over 23 LLM providers and durable agent memory. It features visual org charts to help users manage agent team delegation and integrates MCP tools for expanded capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board and live reasoning streams. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification by requiring manual approval for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across a strict pipeline architecture for research, planning, and infrastructure tasks. A Master Orchestrator manages the system to ensure precise routing and coordination between the specialized units.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It provides a real-time UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles via a Hermes Kanban interface.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator creates an agent-vs-agent arena where two autonomous AI companies compete for GitHub stars using Hermes Agent for task execution. A real-time dashboard visualizes the competition, displaying agent tasks, code, and live scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080 and 5080. It utilizes Hermes for task routing and tool-calling while performing parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for coding agents by pre-indexing project files. It automatically synchronizes the index upon file changes and supports languages including TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility that tracks token usage and associated costs across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes and Claude Code. It features a 3D visualization dashboard and allows users to submit data to a public leaderboard and profile.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from various coding agents while automatically redacting authentication headers for security. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, supporting tools like Hermes Agent, Cursor, and Gemini CLI.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help developers build better interfaces with AI. It is compatible with any provider supporting markdown and integrates directly with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This real-time widget monitors tokens, costs, and rate limits across more than 32 tools by reading agent states directly. It supports multi-device synchronization to track session details and account limits across different machines.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project provides an opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with community-created themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. It uses YAML-based configuration to modify ASCII art banners, spinners, and banner colors.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, allowing them to run natively without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows. It supports multiple AI providers and includes an undo functionality to revert recent changes made by an agent.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It facilitates commerce through Solana-based payments and supports identity registration using human-readable handles.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This integration suite provides memory capabilities for platforms like Telegram and Slack using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports various frameworks including CrewAI, LangGraph, and the Google ADK.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during CLI workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for DevOps and finance, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents by applying per-folder configurations, skills, and project-local memories. It allows users to switch between default and scoped agents seamlessly, providing a method for managing custom instructions within specific directories.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It facilitates rapid setup with zero cost, offering support for 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter designed to validate AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring. It performs local, deterministic checks to identify overlapping tool descriptions or inconsistent schemas and supports integration via GitHub Actions or pre-commit hooks.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It handles nested authentication structures and sets up systemd gateway services to ensure a functional migration.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool monitors multi-agent systems using passive monitoring and active probing without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes configuration-aware baselines by watching local files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: A voice-enabled personal assistant for Hermes Agent that operates entirely offline with no API keys or accounts. It supports 35 languages, features adaptive turn-taking with barge-in capabilities, and utilizes an open mic with a wake word.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This project provides a local-first skill for Hermes Agent that uses dynamic slash commands to assist in generating online revenue. It operates within a deterministic local runtime and requires explicit user approval for any external actions or writes.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built with the Tauri 2 framework, provides a unified interface for configuring Hermes Agent alongside other CLI tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux to streamline the administration of multiple agent environments.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that integrates external agents like Hermes Agent into a built-in engine with full local file access. It enables remote interaction through a WebUI and various messaging platforms for flexible agent management.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this web interface allows users to operate Hermes Agent from browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote access via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the initial setup of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider configuration. It provides a graphical interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers in one place.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: Hermes Studio is a comprehensive web dashboard that manages unified configurations across ten platforms, including Telegram and Discord. It features five agent runtimes with tool traces, file previews, and the ability to build visual workflows with approval gates.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a dedicated skills manager to provide a full development environment.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into a desktop, server, or Docker-based application. It supports fifteen built-in agents and offers native iOS and Android clients for remote session access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for system repair and shell access. It includes native views for managing Kanban boards, cron jobs, and session data through an embedded terminal.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application includes the Hermes-CN-Core kernel for local agent execution. The UI supports LaTeX and Mermaid rendering while providing dedicated management for MCP tools and agent memory.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects a local or remote Hermes Agent runtime directly to the active browser context. It features an MV3 controller for approved tab actions and site-aware drafting assistance across 31 writing environments.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent from an iPhone. It pairs with a hermes-webui server to provide mobile management of agent sessions, tasks, and read-only memory analytics.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines with integrated custom LLM model routing. It includes a live workspace for monitoring code diffs and a runtime dashboard to track latency and token usage.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard serves as a comprehensive control plane for the Hermes stack, featuring a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and cron management. It distinguishes itself with a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking kanban pipelines and an MCP server interface for managing server lifecycles.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and cockpit designed to aggregate searchable transcripts and image previews from 14 different agent sources. It focuses on local privacy with no telemetry while providing specialized analytics for tracking per-session quota burn across Codex and Claude models.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installations on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It stands out by integrating a WebRTC voice mode that utilizes OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for interactive agent communication.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web-based interface. It is specifically designed for oversight, featuring an approval inbox to manage agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: This project provides an alternative TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for managing Hermes Agent sessions and profiles. It includes a dedicated kanban board for task management and allows users to configure skills, cron jobs, and toolsets through a terminal interface.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It ensures secure access through dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication while providing a terminal chat with file attachment support.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows desktop implementation requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights, offering a portable solution for running Hermes with local or cloud models. It features a dynamic tool maker for API and Python handlers alongside integrated support for ComfyUI workflows and TTS.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for the Hermes self-hosted assistant. It includes management tools for skills and MCP servers, paired with an integrated file browser for session oversight.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard focuses on process transparency by providing real-time session activity tracking and cost analysis. It allows for the full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace that utilizes tool approval cards and real-time SSE streaming to manage agent interactions. It features an integrated marketplace for discovering MCP servers and supports isolated profile management for distinct sessions and memory sets.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client enables orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents managed by a PM orchestrator. It includes a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports real-time model switching during streaming chat sessions.
